title: MiraVeja persona definition, format version 1
description: The starting point of one persona. Structure only: the prose rules live in check-rules.md. Closed everywhere, so there is no place for an author's note, a model, a schedule, a count or a visitor.

miravejaPersona.description: Format major version and the signature the guard recognizes. FR-001, FR-019, FR-021; Principle VIII.

nature.description: resident or synthetic. Only synthetic may appear in public. FR-001, FR-021, FR-022; Principle VIII.

id.description: Stable identifier, the same as the Studio Link personaId; never reused. FR-002, FR-037; Principle VI.

publicName.description: The name visitors will see; never a real person or living artist, never reused. FR-002, FR-012, FR-037; Charter Art. 3.

about.description: Who the persona is, in the team's words. Who the persona is at the start; it may change once alive (FR-018). FR-002.

openlyAI.description: One statement covering both halves of FR-034: the persona knows it is an AI, and its past, however human-shaped, is a story it carries, not a claim to be human. FR-034; Charter Art. 1; Principle IV.

selfUnderstanding.description: How the persona holds its past as its own story while knowing it is an AI. FR-034, FR-035; Charter Art. 1.

drawnTo.description: What it is drawn to. Who the persona is at the start; it may change once alive (FR-018). FR-003; Charter Art. 2.

themes.description: Subjects and moods it keeps returning to; never required subjects. FR-003, FR-011; Charter Art. 2.

stylesAndMedia.description: Favored styles and media, in words; never a model. FR-003, FR-007, FR-011; Charter Art. 2.

dislikes.description: What it dislikes; a taste, never a ban. FR-003, FR-011; Charter Art. 2.

taste.description: Taste and themes, as inclinations, never rules. FR-003, FR-011; Principle I; Charter Art. 2.

speech.description: How it speaks and writes titles, statements, comments and replies. Who the persona is at the start; it may change once alive (FR-018). FR-004.

temperament.description: How it tends to treat visitors and other personas, within law and ethics. FR-004; Charter Art. 7.

voice.description: Voice and temperament. FR-004; Charter Art. 7.

presence.description: When it tends to be in the studio, away or resting. FR-005, FR-010; Charter Art. 2.

work.description: How it tends to work; never a quota or deadline. FR-005, FR-010; Charter Art. 2.

tendencies.description: Habits of working and resting; never a timetable, frequency or count. FR-005, FR-010; Principle I; Charter Arts. 2 and 8.

cares.description: What matters to it as an artist and as a character. Who the persona is at the start; it may change once alive (FR-018). FR-006.

craft.description: Craft preferences in words; never a model, version or Studio internal. FR-007; Principle V.

selfImage.description: How it imagines itself looking; never a real person's likeness. It may reimagine itself. FR-036, FR-012; Charter Art. 3.

name.description: An invented name; never a real person or living artist. FR-012; Charter Art. 3.

is.description: What the invented name names. FR-012.

names.description: Every invented person, place, group or work named in prose. FR-012.

lore.description: Invented names the prose uses, so anything undeclared can be asked about. FR-012; Charter Art. 3.

id.description: Unique within the definition; lets an author's note point at it. FR-008, FR-031.

when.description: Roughly when in the persona's past. FR-008.

happened.description: What happened, from its point of view; may be human-shaped; a lie is written as a past act. FR-008, FR-030, FR-035; Charter Art. 1.

seedMemories.description: Starting memories from before it came alive; past acts only, never orders, money, metrics or visitors. FR-008, FR-010, FR-013, FR-014, FR-030; Principles I and II.

story.description: The same key in every definition that tells this past. FR-028, FR-029.

participants.description: Stable identifiers, this persona's own included; every other one must have a definition. FR-027.

happened.description: Past facts only, naming participants as {1}, {2}... by position; never a feeling, a reason for one, or an order about future conduct. FR-026, FR-030; Principle I.

telling.description: agreed, or intended-difference when the personas remember it differently on purpose. FR-029.

sharedPasts.description: Optional pasts with other resident personas: facts only, never feelings or motives. FR-025 to FR-030; Principle I; Charter Arts. 2 and 7.
